name: Strasbourg

queries.query: Strasbourg official cadastral parcel map public GIS API cadastre parcels
queries.result: Found the first-party Strasbourg Open Data cadastral-parcels dataset and API, produced by the City and Eurometropolis of Strasbourg; its official page documents parcel polygons, native parcel identity, and GeoJSON export.

queries.query: Strasbourg cadastre officiel carte parcelles API données cadastrales
queries.result: La recherche a trouvé le jeu de données officiel « Parcelles cadastrales » de la Ville et de l’Eurométropole de Strasbourg et son API publique; la fiche décrit les champs, la licence Etalab et le GeoJSON en EPSG:4326.

registryBasis: The first-party municipal/metropolitan cadastral parcel dataset identifies Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg as producer/manager and covers the Eurométropole territory; this is local cadastral-source evidence, while the retained response is a bounded sample.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official metadata documents cadastral parcels managed by the Géomatique et Connaissance du Territoire service, GeoJSON EPSG:4326 export, and open Etalab v2 licence.
Anonymous metadata exposes num_dept, num_com, nom_com, n_section, n_parcelle, id_parcellaire, and geo_shape.
General national lead found in discovery; not used because the first-party Strasbourg service was available.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official page confirmed 232103 records and documented the Explore API 2.1 records endpoint.
Anonymous metadata returned schema; no unsafe fields were requested.
Municipality query returned 3 records from 48146 Strasbourg records with native IDs and GeoJSON polygons.
Exact WUP point used without shifting; bounded query returned IDs 674820040083, 674820040082, 674820090052.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: First-party Strasbourg/Eurométropole cadastral parcel dataset and anonymous API.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipality-filtered and 1000 m spatially bounded responses with safe native IDs and GeoJSON geometry.

nativeFieldMapping.retainedIdentityProvenance: Official metadata describes id_parcellaire as the unique parcel identifier; retained GeoJSON uses the returned value verbatim.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Exact WUP point centered a bounded 1000 m query; no coordinate shift was used. Returned nearby polygons, not a claim that the point itself is inside one.

remainingUncertainty: Three nearby polygons verify anonymous access and schema, but not complete Strasbourg coverage, update reliability, adapter compatibility, or production integration.
